messages:
amy_marketing: Heads-up — we saw a spike in unclaimed inbound leads overnight for EMEA. ~120 leads with enrichment lagged > 8m, hit the round-robin and then timed out. Anyone else seeing the same? :eyes:
ben_sales_ops: saw it in the dashboard. a lot of those had `lead.score` populated late from enrichment job, so RR skipped them.
cheng_revops: confirmed — enrichment lambda had a retry storm around 02:12 UTC, caused backlog. HubSpot webhook retries delivered late, assignment TTL expired at 5m.
devon_eng: thanks. current RR logic uses `claimable_if_enriched == true` and a 5m claim timeout. we can either extend TTL or add a geo-fallback check that routes stale-but-enriched leads to overflow. thoughts?
amy_marketing: extension seems simplest short-term. but longer-term we need predictable SLA so sales doesn't miss followups. can we do a quick toggle? :pray:
ben_sales_ops: for EMEA we should extend to 10m and enable an immediate fallback to SDR-overflow pool when TTL hits 10m and enrichment status == "pending" but enrichment timestamp < 15m. that avoids cold misses.
devon_eng: I can push a hotfix to the HubSpot workflow/round-robin service. propose patch: set assignment_ttl=600s for regions [EMEA,APAC], and add fallback rule: `if ttl_expired and enriched==false and enrichment_attempts>=1 -> assign overflow_pool`
cheng_revops: add a monitoring alert pls — sample query: `count(leads where region=="EMEA" and assigned==false and now() - enrichment_ts > 600) > 5` and a small Playbook entry for SDRs to check overflow queue.
amy_marketing: cool. can we also update the handoff doc with example HubSpot workflow snippet? devon, ping when deployed and I'll notify Sales + CS.
devon_eng: deploying now to canary (svc: rr-assign) — rollout will be 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 12m. deploy bot: started rollout for rr-assign @ 10% (sha: ab12cd3).
amy_marketing: awesome — once canary passes, i'll post a short note in #salesops and tag @ben_sales_ops & @cheng_revops so they can watch.
ben_sales_ops: if there's any regression, revert plan: toggle assignment_ttl back to 300s and disable geo-fallback. keep me posted. :+1:
hs_sync_bot: HubSpot webhook queue length spike detected at 2026-03-21T02:11:34Z — average processing latency 550s -> alert suppressed for rolling deploy.
amy_marketing: thx everyone. follow-up: i'll add a one-paragraph blurb to the inbound playbook and schedule a 15m sync with Sales Ops tomorrow to confirm new SLOs.
